The '''Camaria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Tarabba sector/Legends|Tarabba sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] known as [[Camarian crystal]].<ref name="PiratesPrivateers">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Camarian crystal]]|system=Camaria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Camaria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-19.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
